### About This Product

HOROW integrated smart toilet taking it home and enjoy when you need to use the toilet, the microwave induction of the smart toilet will know you are coming. Soon, the lid automatically opens as if saying "Welcome". When you take your rightful place upon the toilet, you can feel the warmth of the heated seat. The seat has seat-warming temperature settings that are especially useful during the cold of winter. An automatic air deodorizer activates to hide the unpleasant smells. As your journey comes to a close, you can access the rotating switch or remote control and start the cleansing process. A self-cleaning wand will appear to wash your nether regions. You are in total control, as you are able to select a front to cleanse, soft rear cleanses, rear cleanse, oscillating cleanse, or pulsating cleanse. The variable temperature and pressure settings allow you to adjust the warmth and intensity of the spray. You may start the air dryer to reduce the moisture left behind from the cleaning. The powerful flushing of the 3D tornado flushes, and the bowl bottom flushes, aided by the premium glaze whisks away all of the evidence. Soon, the lid automatically closes as if saying "goodbye".

### Highlights

- Powerful flush toilet - tankless toilet with powerful flush core, which can provide eco-friendly tornado flushing with a few water consumption (1.03 gpf)
- Bidet toilet combo - bidet with air-in wonder wave technology uses hygienic filtered water and adjustable water pressure/temperature/cleaning position, rear wash, front wash, constant temp washing, lady care wash, strong wash, multi cleanse modes
- Elegant modern toilet - the modern skirt design toilet combined with the automatic opening/closing function of the lid brings you an elegant experience
- Comfortable smart toilet for bathroom - the elongated heated toilet seat transmits warmth to the person above, the warm wind drives away the discomfort caused by the wet
- Automatic toilet - electric toilet with sensor on bidet seat, when people leaving, the toilet will flush to make your hands-free, you can also control the flush with the kick button or remote
- Intelligent protection - the toilet has a built-in smart chip and sensors to avoid the dangers caused by high temperature, leakage, and high water pressure
- Power outage flushing batteries need to be purchased separately
